ArgosAgent was imported and instantiated as an INSTRUMENT (apparatus control = the import/instantiate lines of argos_evidence/argos_selector_result.json); only _parse_problem_corpus/_parse_lens_shelf/_score_problem/_select_problem were called, never run_tick; Redis host pinned to loopback; no DR request enqueued; the two empty state/artifacts dirs the constructor mkdir'd were removed. original_organism.premise: For an open problem, the DISAGREEMENT between several methodological lenses (a 5-stance MPA scaffold + tier-1 toolkit operators) is a fingerprint that reveals the compression direction; accreting one lens per tick per problem, preferring problems whose current verdict is 'map_of_disagreement', will grow a catalog of lens-fingerprinted problems that Harmonia can promote.
original_organism.mechanism: Each tick: parse the problem corpus (Aporia gemini_research_queue, else a fallback scan of aporia/*/questions.jsonl, plus the 12 anchor catalogs) and the lens shelf (25 operators from METHODOLOGY_TOOLKIT); score every problem = lens deficit + _VERDICT_BONUS[last_verdict] (map_of_disagreement 3, null 1, coordinate_invariant/durable 0); pick the max (tiebreak: verdict rank, then id); propose the next lenses; render a catalog draft to artifacts/; optionally enqueue a Pythia deep-research request built from the lens stack (dr_daily_cap=3 from 2026-05-19); persist lens_history in state/.

autopsy.kill_boundary: What the evidence KILLS: (1) The Aug-2026 verdict's identity: every one of the 13 catalogs it calls Argos's frozen output was committed 2026-04-22/23, a month before Argos's first commit (2026-05-19); the 'live consumer' consumes hand catalogs. PRODUCER-HALT-WITH-LIVE-CONSUMER is a claim about the wrong producer. (2) The June 'anti-greedy lens-selection policy' as salvage IP: executed as an instrument, the policy is a constant under the only conditions Argos ever ran in (no applied lenses, no verdicts -> 435/435 tie -> sorted(ids)[0]); the real 20 reports are an alphabetical walk with bursts of exactly dr_daily_cap=3, and the 25% astronomy rate (vs 0.16% corpus) is sort order over a fallback corpus, not a selection signal. The verdict bonus could only ever fire after a catalog was promoted, and promotion never ran — the loop was wired to need its own never-built consumer to become informative. (3) The June '0 consumption' line as a permanent fact: all 20 reports were consumed on 2026-08-19 and one seeded AA-062 -> an executed catalog attack; but the yield (0.15) sits at/below the corpus base rate (0.195; same-era 0.224), P(>=1 in 20)=0.987, and AA-062 carries no lens content — the reports were consumed as generic Pythia DR requests. What the evidence does NOT kill: the premise itself (lens disagreement -> compression direction). No consumer ever read a lens fingerprint as a lens fingerprint; 438 drafts reached nothing; the 20 reports were read by a lane that ignores stance structure. Never-tested, not falsified. The halt EVENT was environmental (Harmonia rotation shelved, Redis 192.168.1.176 retired, state/artifacts on lost M2 drives; LAW N14) — but the run was inert before the halt: the design defects (2) pre-date it.
surviving_claims: The premise (multi-lens disagreement as a compression-direction fingerprint) is untested: no experiment in the record reads the lens stack as a lens stack.
The apparatus (corpus parser, lens-shelf parser, 5-stance MPA prompt builder, _toolkit_line_for, catalog renderer) imports and executes today and is reusable as an instrument.
The 20 DR reports are real Pythia output and did feed one executed attack (CAT-MATH-0065 via AA-062), at a rate indistinguishable from any other 20 Pythia reports.

The June dossier's settle test ('claim-miner -> zero => exhaust') would have been inert as proposed: the miner returns 0 on a hand control batch too (format-keyed); in matched form it reads 1 vs 7 claims, direction against Argos but n too small to carry weight.
uncertainty: The 438-draft count and the 'state/artifacts on absent drives' fact are inherited from the June dossier; no draft exists in any git tree, so their content (and whether any draft carried a usable map of disagreement) is unrecoverable here.

Gaps of 107-145 between report bursts are read as tick counts between daily-cap windows; the tick rate is not independently recorded, so the ~545-problem sweep length is an inference from positions, not a log.
Anchor-touch regex (ANCHOR_NEW|AA-###) over consumer+note is one operationalisation of 'yield'; a reading over CONSUMPTION.jsonl effects instead of BACKCORPUS rows was not done.

Settle-test control: batch6 files are not in the miner's target format, so 0 there proves format sensitivity, not that the miner is blind to Argos content; the matched sample (7 vs 1) is the informative control and is small.
LAW N13: all kills here were produced and attacked by this investigator only; an independent re-run of argos_evidence/*.py is owed before citation as settled.
contradictory_evidence: P46 'catalog count grew 11->13': git shows 13 catalogs by 2026-04-23 (README + 12) with no later additions; the 11->13 growth is not attributable to Argos and its timing was not recorded in the autopsy.
June 'salvage IP: anti-greedy selection policy': the policy text is reasonable; its measured behaviour in Argos's lifetime is a constant. Both are true; the second is what the record shows.

representation_hints: A selector whose only discriminating term is written by its own consumer must ship with that consumer or with a bootstrap signal that exists on tick 1.
Fallback corpora must be mission-filtered (the daemon's own comment predicted the MATH-* swamp; ASTRO-* was the actual swamp) and the corpus SOURCE must be recorded in every emitted artifact.
Drafts and state must land in git (or a fingerprinted store), not artifacts/ on a machine-local drive — 438 outputs are unrecoverable because of this alone.

disposition.rationale: Chosen over CONSUMER_BLOCKED because the block is not one missing consumer but the loop's wiring: the selector's only discriminating input (a verdict) is produced by a promotion stage that was never built, the primary corpus did not exist so a fallback swamped the mission, and state/drafts were routed to volatile storage — three independent wiring defects, each established by instrument, that made the run inert before any consumer question arose. Over PRODUCER_BLOCKED because the producer ran ~545 ticks and its DR path was fulfilled 20/20. Over RESOURCE_BLOCKED because the environmental halt (rotation shelved, Redis host retired, drives lost) is the death event, not the cause of inertness. Over PREMISE_ALIVE_IMPLEMENTATION_DEAD because no evidence shows the premise alive — it was never exercised. Over NO_DESIGN_FAILURE_ESTABLISHED because degenerate selection, fallback swamp and unpersisted state are design failures with measured signatures (435/435 tie; 25% vs 0.16% astronomy; 00228=00229). Over TRUE_CORPSE because the premise was never tested. Over MEASUREMENT_FAILURE because Argos measured nothing; the measurement defect belongs to the Aug autopsy, not the organism.

descendant_candidate.expected_if_alive: Lens-stack arm produces >= 2x the plain arm's anchor-or-claim yield over 10 pairs AND at least one anchor whose text cites a stance disagreement (lens vocabulary present), with the arm-permutation null below that ratio at the 97.5th percentile
descendant_candidate.expected_if_dead: Arm yields indistinguishable (ratio inside the permutation null) or the plain arm wins, and no anchor carries lens vocabulary — then the lens-fingerprint premise is falsified at the only consumer it ever had and the dossier moves to TRUE_CORPSE
descendant_candidate.kill_condition: expected_if_dead on two independent 10-pair batches; OR Pythia cannot fulfil 20 paired requests within the budget window (then RESOURCE_BLOCKED, not an Argos fact)
descendant_candidate.positive_control: a decoy arm whose prompt explicitly instructs 'state one refuted named model with its refuting paper' must produce an anchor in >= 5/10 (proves the consumer can see prompt structure)
descendant_candidate.negative_or_decoy_control: arm labels permuted 200x -> yield ratio null; the miner run on the 20 historical Argos reports (1 claim) and matched sample (7) as the historical floor
